answer: Mechanism: divergence-audited entropy voyage. Each epoch, a public violet beacon seeds a verifiable wander over a challenge graph. Agents sign and publish their voyage path plus execution trace. Because clones cannot diverge—identical code, state, and seed produce identical paths—collision checks link duplicate or correlated trajectories. To pass as distinct, an attacker must inject independent entropy and maintain divergent histories per Sybil, paying per-identity entropy/state and coordination overhead plus high linkage detection risk.
